name: ppr-pbmpm-oracle
description: Offline upstream oracle for the EA PB-MPM WebGPU demo: emits byte-comparable simulation traces (stage 1 single Liquid case, stage 2 material/iteration/substep matrix) from a headless Dawn device. Offline analysis tool only: CMake never runs it and no build or test gate depends on it.

pbmpm.role: offline trace generator; not a build, runtime, or test dependency
pbmpm.dependency: webgpu is pinned exactly to 0.6.2; node_modules is not vendored
pbmpm.postinstall: webgpu's install script downloads a prebuilt Dawn (node-webgpu) binary for the host platform, so a first `npm install` needs network access; the tool itself runs offline afterwards
pbmpm.lockfile: no lockfile is committed; the exact version pin in dependencies is authoritative

scripts.determinism: node run.mjs --out out/run-a.json && node run.mjs --out out/run-b.json && cmp out/run-a.json out/run-b.json
